selected_evidence.requirement: Local caching DNS resolver for system applications
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration passed syntax validation; dnsmasq was enabled and listening on TCP/UDP 127.0.0.1:53. Cache counters showed 26 locally answered queries versus 3 forwarded queries.
NetworkManager and /etc/resolv.conf use 127.0.0.1, while external names resolved successfully before and after restart through upstream 10.100.240.1.

Healthy baseline boot ID 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, and the recovered boot ID changed to 34e2678f-7f6d-42cb-b605-5a67b6437640. dnsmasq, NetworkManager, listeners, configuration, external resolution, and cache activity all recovered.
